claim: Account delivery-oracle native fixture at frozen inputs; no wrapper or immutable aggregate qualification

summary.claim: Only this bounded selection; no native aggregate or release qualification.

limits: Exactly six unchanged native cases run under delivery-oracle-native-fixture: refusals/finals in forward/reverse order, plus refusalId and finalCutoff mutation controls in forward order. Existing 120-second wrapper/file allowance, 60-second per-case limits, 15-second browser startup and 5-second drain grace are retained. No generated native histories or crash cuts execute.

The static census previously refused string-plus-boolean titles. A six-line finite-interpreter extension supports only string/boolean concatenation in either order. Boolean arithmetic, object/function coercion, dynamic calls, null/undefined concatenation and duplicate names still refuse. The focused generated test failed before repair and all 160 generated populations pass afterward for Node and Vitest; all 195 prior general contracts and 1651 identities remain unchanged.

Each case uses existing owned CDP, in-memory builds, a selected synthetic Account and temporary service custody. The Node oracle independently opens the synthetic service acceptance seal and signs contradictory refusal or final-head claims. These proofs are not issued by the live HTTP service state machine. Shared active delivery-ledger code is exercised; this does not reinstate retired-v8 product paths or prove real multi-device service composition.

The independent constraint reference imports no production reducer or verifier. Expected full state includes accepted prefix, first final cutoff, first refusal identity, conflict/publication and exact submitted/response wires. A single checked observation injection copies those fields from describeDelivery into a test-only object in both baseline and mutant builds. Native cases compare full state after each proof, page replacement and compaction. The separate finite-world/oracle histories are not rerun by this native selection.

Each mutation anchor is unique and exactly one transform hit is required. refusalId changes first-identity retention to last-identity replacement; finalCutoff changes first-cutoff retention to last-cutoff replacement. Native controls require a full-state inequality after the second claim while publication is still conflict, and a positive mismatch count. The assertion does not separately name the differing field; the constrained mutation and retained exact anchors identify the intended defect. Baseline cases must equal the independent reference.

Logical census reads decrypted authenticated heads/outbound records and spool witness after closing the editor. It compares original ledger rows, exact response-wire order and witness event count increasing once per retained proof. Duplicate and later terminal claims must report recorded=false. The census does not compare physical ciphertext files or assert its returned counter value.

Visible master text and original envelopes are compared throughout. Each original capture must remain byte-equal by identity. New captures are permitted only with expected principal, human actor and empty [0,0] updates; this is not an exact no-new-capture count. The instrumented done/env/v2 encryption invocation count remains unchanged after initial preparation. These assertions do not claim zero disk writes, all cryptographic activity or an exhaustive nonce audit.

Cold closes the page and creates another in the same browser context. No renderer/browser/service crash or fresh-profile restore is induced. Product/native/helper/wrapper bytes remain unchanged. Optional old-reader branches are not called, so no historical inputs are credited. Complete wrapper outputs, generated service/oracle histories, vector ordering and reproduction remain separate obligations.

All 93 pure runner checks, five current Vitest-process controls, typecheck and scoped style/planning/authority/signature checks pass. Unchanged 23 Node-owner and 14 native-owner controls retain prior evidence. The 52 personal/vector pins, L-2 and historical evidence remain unchanged. Ledger orphan classification, core receive loaded-host headroom, capture map-refresh/byte-length follow-ups and previous editing/handoff deadline evidence remain open. This frozen-input selection with uncommitted adapter changes is not immutable release qualification.

The passing Node file took 113.095 seconds of 120, leaving 6.905 seconds (about 5.8%) of execution headroom. Stage time was 117.760 seconds including setup/drain; total selection time was 143.695 including fingerprinting. Preserve the existing allowance and this loaded-host observation; a single pass does not establish aggregate timing reliability.
